sum: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited files mandatory substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 regarding Indraprastha Medical Corporation Limited.
detail: Apollo Hospitals submitted to NSE a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011. This is a mandatory notification when an acquirer breaches specified shareholding thresholds (typically 25% or 51%). The disclosure document filed on the NSE corporate actions portal is the primary evidence of the transaction announcement phase.
